meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: Claude 会当你的写作搭子：和你一起搭大纲、查资料并加引用、优化开头 Hook、逐段给反馈，同时尽量保留你的语气。产出大纲、引用列表、逐段修改建议和全文审阅清单。
howto.when: 当你撰写博客、深度文章、技术文档等内容，或要求搭大纲、研究主题并加引用、改进开头时，它会接管。

say.text: 帮我给「远程办公的利与弊」这篇文章列个大纲
say.note: 它会先问受众、篇幅和目标，再给结构化大纲

say.text: 研究这个主题的相关数据，并给我的大纲加上引用
say.note: 会整理关键数据和来源，标进大纲对应位置

say.text: 这是我写的开头，帮我把 Hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 会分析现有开头并给出几个备选版本

howto.what_en: Claude becomes your writing partner: it builds outlines with you, researches topics and adds citations, improves your hook, and reviews each section as you write, while keeping your voice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write blog posts, articles, or technical docs, or when you ask it to build an outline, research a topic with citations, or improve your hook.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about remote work
say_en.note: It asks about audience, length, and goal first

say_en.text: Research this topic and add citations to my outline
say_en.note: It gathers key data and sources, marked into the outline

say_en.text: Here's my introduction - help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: It analyzes the current hook and offers alternatives
